subject: Midwest Dev Night — request for supplemental trial pool
messages:
From: DevMidwest Events <events@devmidwest.org>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: MidWEST Dev Night — need 120 extra trial codes

Hi Monica,

Quick note — we just had a larger-than-expected RSVP spike for the Chicago Dev Night on Sept 24 and our speaker partner asked if we can extend the Redwood trial offer. We originally planned 200 promo codes; we need +120 more to cover late registrants and onsite signups.

Event details: "MidWEST Dev Night" — 9/24, Hyatt Regency, Chicago. Audience: local startups / platform engineers, expected conversion to paid POC motion is high.

Could Redwood provide an additional 120 trial codes (30-day, 10k token starter) and a short blurb we can use in the event slide? We can add your logo to the meetup page in return.

Attachments: devnight_requested_codes.xlsx (spreadsheet with current code allocation and attendee list sample)

Appreciate a quick confirmation — registrations are rolling in.

Thanks,
Alyssa Reed
Community Lead, DevMidwest
alyssa.reed@devmidwest.org

--
DevMidwest is a volunteer-run community of regional devs.
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T10:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MidWEST Dev Night — need 120 extra trial codes

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding a partner request. DevMidwest had a last-minute RSVP surge and wants +120 30-day trial codes (10k token starter). Alyssa is offering logo placement and slide shoutout.

Quick asks:
- Marissa: are we ok from a promotional credit budget perspective (estimate: 120 * starter = ~X token cost, I can pull exact numbers)?
- Karthik: can your team mint a CSV of 120 single-use codes with a simple redemption flow by EOD Friday 9/11?

I'd like to get this out fast if we have budget. If you say go, I'll include a 1-paragraph blurb and the required legal-ish language for the signup form.

Thanks,
Monica
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
